about_the_game:
Two additional songs that can be enjoyed in Capcom Fighting Collection 2's Museum mode.
CAP-JAMS, our sound team's official band, strived for greatness in creating these triumphant tunes!

Included Content
The following tracks have been added to the Music feature of the Museum mode for the following games:

- Soy Sauce for Geese - Arranged by CAP-JAMS:
Capcom vs. SNK: Millennium Fight 2000 Pro

- Rival Schools Medley - Arranged by CAP-JAMS:
Project Justice

Note: These tracks cannot be used as BGM while playing the game.
